name: Crab, Muck, Giant
body:
Giant Muck Crab
CR 1

XP 400
N Medium vermin
Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft., Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 10, flat-footed 16 (+6 natural)
hp 19 (3d8+6)
Fort +5, Ref +1, Will +1
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee 2 claws +5 (1d4+2 plus grab)
Special Attacks constrict (1d4+2)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

STR 16, Dex 11, Con 14, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 1
Base Attack +2; CMB +5 (+9 grapple), CMD 15 (27 vs. trip)
Skills Stealth +0 (+4 in muddy or swampy terrain), Swim +8; Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth in muddy or swampy terrain
SQ amphibious

ECOLOGY

Environment edges of lakes and rivers, swamps
Organization solitary or caste (2 – 12)
Treasure none

What you thought was a muddy bolder turned out to be a giant crab!

The muck crab has lived for a very long time…
